item.description:
Teleprompter: the Delivery level is yellow

  • On the Delivery level, the pause and section chips, the section bar, the line beside the reading band and the voice-follow pill are now the Teleprompter yellow instead of blue, the same as on the iPhone. Time stays green and Smart stays purple.
  • Nothing else changes in how the teleprompter works.

Also new since 1.2.7

A small fix to the Collage door

  • On Images, if you clicked Collage, cancelled, and then clicked Photo, the new Photo still came with the three-photo layout. Photo now always starts with one photo.
  • Behind the scenes, every door on the library pages (Record, Import, With script, Photo, Collage, New, Paste) is now checked automatically each time the app is tested.

Home's library pages now match the iPhone

  • Video, Images, Audio, Scripts and Slides each open with a big banner in that page's own colour (orange, blue, pink, yellow, green), with its name and how many you have. Search, your plan and the account button stay on the row above it.
  • Under the banner are two or three doors, the quickest ways to start: Video has Record, Import and With script; Images has Photo and Collage; Audio has Record and Import; Scripts has New, Paste and Import; Slides has New and Import. An Import door asks for the file first, so cancelling makes nothing.
  • A Recent row shows your three newest on each page (it hides when you have three or fewer). Folders and the full list follow, as before.
  • Cards, tiles, the orange buttons and the selected sidebar row have a thin, flat, darker bottom edge, like the iPhone's. Nothing moved or changed size.

Scripts

  • Every script tile shows how long it takes to read, in a small yellow pill (for example 2:10), worked out from that script's own speed and text size. On the Scripts page the line under the name shows its words and speed.
  • Paste (at the top of Scripts, and as a door) makes a new script from the text you copied, named after its first line, and opens it on the Prompter tab. With nothing copied it says "Nothing to paste yet".

Audio

  • Audio tiles have a round pink play button: listen without opening the project. Starting another one stops the first; leaving the page or opening a project stops it too.

Photo

  • A new Photo opens on Layout: choose a layout, then drop photos into its spaces. Empty spaces show a blue dashed outline with a plus; click one to choose photos. Photos you already made open as before.
  • The Images page's Collage door starts a Photo with a three-photo layout already picked.

Smart Cut

  • AI Tools › Smart Cut has three quick choices above the slider: Tight, Natural and Relaxed (the same three as the iPhone). The slider is still there to fine-tune; move it anywhere else and no choice is lit.

Languages

  • Counts read correctly in every language ("1 project", "2 projects", and the right forms in French, Spanish and German), and messages that used to be stitched together from pieces are now whole sentences that translate properly.

A small fix to the Collage door

  • On Images, if you clicked Collage, cancelled, and then clicked Photo, the new Photo still came with the three-photo layout. Photo now always starts with one photo.
  • Behind the scenes, every door on the library pages (Record, Import, With script, Photo, Collage, New, Paste) is now checked automatically each time the app is tested.
